column1: # gui-agent-advanced.tsv — GUI scenarios driven by the secondary ("advanced")
# agent when the operator pins one in QCI_AGENT_ADVANCED_CMD (see
# ci/lib/gates/gui.sh, gui_agent_profile). Without that variable this file is
# inert. The profile changes WHO drives a scenario, never what it asserts or
# how it is graded; each attempt log records qci_agent_profile/model.
#   path_suffix  matched against the END of the scenario path at a / boundary
#   reason       the default driver's observed failure mode (run id)
# Keep this list SHORT: a scenario belongs here only when the default driver
# fails it for reasons of its own, not the product's.
